_comment: Catalog of Facetwork DOMAINS (pluggable fwh_* production pipelines) and in-repo EXAMPLES (teaching demos). Single source of truth for fw install/migrate/fleet + compose-env generation. Override per deployment WITHOUT editing any command: set AFL_DOMAINS_FILE=/path (full replace), or drop a gitignored domains.local.json (merged over this file: entries add/replace by key; a top-level "_remove": ["name", ...] drops standard ones). See docs and `fw util gen-compose`.

anthropic.description: Anthropic API wrappers (Messages, Batch, Files, Agent SDK, Claude Code, Computer Use)

osm-lz.description: Continental-scale OSM workflow catalog (depends on fwh_osm)

save-earth.description: Open environmental datasets (OpenLitterMap, EPA Superfund/Brownfields/TRI) → MapLibre HTML maps

sentinel2-landchange.description: Sentinel-2 land-cover change (STAC + COG → NDVI/composite → difference/classify → MapLibre tiled map)

hiv-drug-resistance.description: foreach fan-out over sequences; classic teaching workflow
